records.name: Josephsplatz
records.location: Josephsplatz U-Bahn station public restroom, Maxvorstadt, Munich 80798; exact rebuilt toilet entrance unverified.
records.description: Splashd's Munich archive claims encounters in a station toilet without a date. The U-Bahn Josephsplatz WC was closed for repairs for over five years, confirmed by 2024–2025 local reporting. A neighbourhood report in the December 2025 St Joseph parish magazine states the facility reopened after roughly six and a half years. This indicates the toilet may now exist again, but the reopened layout and any current cruising have no corroboration. Do not reuse old descriptions of stalls or suggest unwanted sexual contact in a public bathroom.
records.original_source_description: You don't have to wait long to have someone join you. There are also some group activity. Two lock-ups for more private things. Stand at the stools and you'll soon be conscious that other people are up for something Just take care. Be discreet.
